dialogue.sit: That's right. Ever since she said she intends to "reclaim" Paimon when we next meet, I figured reconciliation was out of the question.

dialogue.t: Against an opponent of this caliber, deliberating over our allegiances would waste time we do not have. We must join forces unreservedly with whomever we can if we are to stand anything like a fighting chance.
You're going to challenge the Ruler of Death... just for Paimon? But... but Paimon's only...

dialogue.sit: No buts.
I won't back down when it comes to you, Paimon.

dialogue.t: Thank you... Thank you... Oh gee, now Paimon doesn't even know what to say! A—Anyway, Paimon's super, super touched!
The Tsaritsa will return in triumph in short order, and the Fatui shall hold internal discussions regarding the enemy. The time for us to meet again will come very soon.

dialogue.sit: Got it. Thanks for your help with Paimon. I'll be sure to look after her for you.

dialogue.t: Um, there was just one another thing... Well, just a request, really. Paimon reeeally wants to see what this Mistilteinn thingy you're gonna use against the Heavenly Principles looks like!
Of course, Paimon knows it's top secret and stuff, but she just had to ask. It's okay if the answer's no...
Certainly, you may.
Whoa! For real!? Uh... A—Actually, maybe it's best not to...? What if Ronova suddenly pops up again? She might take this chance to—
While the technology is not yet fully developed, it has nevertheless reached the stage where Celestia's creations are unable to damage it. In that regard, you may rest assured.
Ohh... Wow, no wonder Paimon felt so out of sorts recently, even though it was super far away! Alright then, Paimon's ready to take a sneaky peek at this top-secret super weapon!
Huh? Oh, hey there, Odette!
Paimon? You're okay... Thank goodness. You look well, have you recovered?
Long story short... yep! Paimon's all better. What are you doing here? Were you waiting for us?
That's right. When I woke up, I wanted to go in after you, but the guards had woken up as well... It would've been tough to take them on alone, and there was no easy way to sneak past them...
...So I returned the way I came and waited for you here.

dialogue.sit: It was thanks to you that my soul found its way back to my body so quickly. Thank you.

dialogue.t: Huh. That actually worked? Nice. I just figured I'd try my luck when that ominous feeling struck me.
Really, you should be thanking this thing instead...
Anyway, now that things here are all taken care of, I have other things I should get back to...
Ah, Director Chugunov, you're back. We just received notice that Project Stuzha has been suspended, so we've convened an emergency meeting.
This is the preliminary plan. In addition to expanding production capacity, we've also discussed feasible layoff plans to optimize revenue and expenditure structure.
Our calculations indicate that the factory's profits will increase by at least 30%! Just give the word, Director...
That won't be necessary.
Leave the energy for those who need it. Whether they use it just to get by or to run a business, that's up to them.
Start preparing to halt production and lay off the staff. Make sure the workers are able to land on their feet and that they are duly compensated. Thank you all for your hard work during this time.
Uh... Am I hearing you right? Why? After all the tough times we made it through, now is exactly when we should start to turn a profit...
I just... suddenly don't want to do this anymore. Does there have to be a reason?
Iskra... It's time to rest.

Dear esteemed members of the Rokot: Given the effects of Lelek's radical actions upon our organization's reputation and social stability, a decision has been made to permanently withdraw this codename from use.
Considering that Lelek did what they did for the benefit of the people, the Rokot has nevertheless negotiated with the authorities, ultimately securing a waiver for all penalties due to them.
Lelek will be suspended for a period of time. Depending on their future performance, they may be allowed to adopt a new codename and continue acting as part of the Rokot.
The purpose of this notice is to remind everyone once again that motives and methods are equally important when one operates in the shadows.
Even with Project Stuzha's suspension and our interim operational victory, we must guard against complacency and rashness and work to consolidate the progress we have made so far.
"We act only for the greater glory and solidarity of our nation. May the aurora shine ever on and the tundra always stand firm."
"We act only for the greater glory and solidarity of our nation. May the aurora shine ever on and the tundra always stand firm."
Whew... Looks like it's finally over.
You mean for us?
Just thinking out loud.
I've never seen the Snezhnograd Veche so lively before.

dialogue.section: Take a walk around with Paimon

dialogue.t: Ahh, fresh air at last! Paimon's head isn't spinning anymore, and the fever's all gone. Paimon's finally free to fly again...
It's nice to finally know where Paimon came from, too. It did make Paimon a little nervous at first, but it's such a relief now.
Like, who cares if Paimon's a "creation of Celestia"? She's probably not anyone that important. Probably just... "the fairy of food and fun," or something...
And like you said, this doesn't have to change anything between us. You're not gonna just... Hey, hurry up! Why are you walking so slowly?

dialogue.sit: You've spent the last few days lying in bed and stuffing your face. I didn't think you'd be able to fly this fast.

dialogue.t: Says who!? Paimon's as agile as ever! They don't call her "White Floaty" for nothing!
Paimon originally wanted to check out the bookstores in Snezhnograd, but she's more in the mood for flying around right now, so let's save that for later...
Wait, they've got light novels from Yae Publishing House here too... Huh? And this is Paimon's favorite mystery story from Fontaine! Wow, it got a sequel!
The local Snezhnayan books look pretty interesting too, but also kinda heavy... Not the easiest things to lug around...

dialogue.sit: I thought you were in the mood for flying around?

dialogue.t: Paimon can read while she flies!
Hey, look at these two dolls. Which do you like better, {NICKNAME}?

dialogue.sit: (Point to the one that looks like Vodyanitsa)
(Point to the one that looks like Odette)

dialogue.t: Hehe, alright! Boss, we'll take both! Paimon will have the other one.

dialogue.sit: Oh, I thought we were only getting one... Alright, fine, I'll pay.

dialogue.t: There you are. Thanks for visiting.
Paimon will grab this, and then... Huh?
Huh'?
HUH???

dialogue.sit: Pfft...

dialogue.t: How many layers does this thing have!? ...And what are you laughing at? Hmph, you knew all along, didn't you?
A whole bunch of people are gathered over by the plaza... Hey, look, that looks like Tartaglia! Hey, Tartaglia!
I know that voice... Haha, of course — if it isn't Paimon and my old comrade. You're looking well, Paimon. All better?
Yeah! The Jester knew what was wrong and fixed Paimon right up! Hehe, thanks for sending someone to keep Paimon safe, too!
Oh, yeah... About that. That was... kind of embarrassing. Who could've known that our director would go looking for you in person? So sorry for the misunderstanding.
Oh, right, lemme introduce you. This is my little sister, Tonia.
Hello, Tonia!
Hello, hello! Firstly, I'm really sorry about my brother. Sounds like he's caused you no end of trouble.
Haha, hey now, why'd you have to start with that... Not that it isn't true, of course.

dialogue.sit: (So she's the real Tonia...)

dialogue.t: She said you two didn't manage to meet up at the theater. She waited ages for me, and when I didn't show, she got a little worried and went outside.

dialogue.sit: Wait, wait, you mean...
You didn't even tell Tonia I'd be going in your place?

dialogue.t: I know, right!? He didn't bother to say a word to me! I searched up and down the city for him, and he only told me about it when I finally caught him at the gates of Glupov.
I've been rushed off my feet lately, so I didn't get the chance to go home... I just figured {NICKNAME} would fill you in when he(she) got there.
Hmph! Well, the snow was bad, and you're never late, so I was really worried about you! How was I supposed to know that you'd stood me up...
I'm sorry, Tonia, I really am. I'll make it up to you somehow. Just... please don't tell Mom and Dad.

dialogue.sit: (Although the mixup led to a series of misunderstandings, it's probably for the best that the real Tonia didn't get caught up in that mess.)
(Besides, it's obvious that Tartaglia isn't usually one to break a promise. He only gave his ticket to me because he had to look into Lelek.)
It's really my fault for being late.
I should have come find you first.

dialogue.t: Oh, it's fine. It just meant I didn't get to see the show in the end... By the way, what did you think? You were one of the first people to see it, you know!

dialogue.sit: I would say...
The best is yet to come.

dialogue.t: Huh? What kinda review is that...
Hey, look!

quests.description: As the days and nights in the theater passed, you missed and worried for Paimon in equal measure. Yet, as you return to your dwelling, it appears an incident has happened nonetheless…
